decisions.reason: The stricter condition applies to adding secured prospects to HubSpot, not to the spreadsheet's interested-prospect inclusion rule or its deferred lifecycle.
The scheduling trigger and February-to-April date window remain valid; the secured condition governs subsequent HubSpot entry rather than partnership scheduling.
The HubSpot entry condition does not change the outreach cadence, message-delivery method, or outreach lifecycle.
The decision about when to enter a prospect in HubSpot does not alter how Airbnb hosts are selected or screened.
The source changes when a prospect may be entered into HubSpot but does not change the deferred contact-property configuration work or its required fields and permissions.
Social post scheduling and publishing are unrelated to the secured-prospect condition for HubSpot entry.
The source does not change the independent task of researching tools that could make outreach easier.
CJ Dropshipping product-selection criteria are unrelated to Airbnb prospect entry in HubSpot.
The social content-bank artifact and storage requirements are unaffected by the HubSpot entry condition.
Pinterest competitor research and its required links have no semantic relationship to secured Airbnb prospect entry in HubSpot.
